intended_object: Per the docstring, this is the identity-on-points homeomorphism between two chart spaces. One is the analytic affine chart of a cone σ in a subfan. The other is the chart of the same cone viewed in the ambient fan Φ.
explanation: This is bookkeeping, not a mathematical object in its own right. In the mathematics, the chart of σ in the subfan and the chart of σ in the ambient fan are literally the same space. Lean sees two different terms, `(Φ.subfan S hS hface).analyticAffineChartDiagram.obj σ` and `Φ.analyticAffineChartDiagram.obj ⟨σ.1, _⟩`, so the library needs a transport map between them. The definition supplies `Equiv.refl` as the map. It gets continuity in both directions from the lemma `subfan_analyticAffineChartDiagram_obj_str`, which says the two topologies agree, combined with `continuous_id_iff_le`. The map is presumably used to compare the gluing diagram of the subfan with that of the ambient fan. It is an auxiliary identification with no counterpart in the literature beyond "the charts are the same".
